scheme_name: Technology Development And Utilization Programme For Women
other_conditions: Applicants must be institutions/organizations in government, non‑government sectors or professional bodies.
Applicants should have adequate experience in technology development for women and be involved in promotional activities related to science & technology, R&D, entrepreneurship, SME promotion.

Institutions must belong to one of the following categories: receiving annual recurring grants from Central or State Government agencies, registered under the Societies Registration Act, incorporated under the Companies Act, professional & industry associations, or trusts registered under the Indian Trusts Act.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance (partial or full) and technical guidance for projects related to technology development and utilization by women, covering manpower, consumables, travel and miscellaneous expenses.
